'''TK-1016''' was the [[Operating number|designation]] of a [[stormtrooper]] who patrolled the streets of [[Jedha City]], accompanying a [[TX-225 GAVw "Occupier" combat assault tank|combat assault tank]]. He was armed with a [[T-21 light repeating blaster]].<ref name="SWROUVG" />
